# skygo dashboard help names the boundary and no credential.

skygo dashboard --help
stdout 'read-only'
stdout '127.0.0.1 or \[::1\]'
stdout 'one-time login code'
stdout '--listen'
stdout 'never cancels a job'
! stdout 'dashboard-token'
